description: Latin America and Caribbean - Geothermal Inventory is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Geothermal", published or maintained by Xiaoping Wang (World Bank Group). The LAC (Latin America and Caribbean) Geothermal Inventory compiles data on geothermal resources throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. Both developed and undeveloped resources are included. It contains information from publicly available sources. Coverage: Latin America and the Caribbean. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Geothermal. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
